sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:108

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:108:1
items.html: It is necessary that there be made there, in between, the existence of one light through these two kinds of hairs, of the beard and of the head, etc. And from this light that surrounds them, they attain the discernment of the Katnut [smallness/infancy] of the Partzuf of AB, as above at length. But ZON as yet have nothing at all of the discernment of AB, and therefore they must first receive the discernment of the Katnut of AB and afterward its Gadlut [greatness/adulthood]; for this is the rule: no degree comes out at one time, but in two times — first the Katnut and afterward the Gadlut, as above.
